title: AppleEventCreateIntent
description: Create an event in an Apple calendar through EventKit. Requires signed approval.

start.description: Timed event: the start instant. All-day event: midnight (T00:00:00) on the first day; only the date as written is used, in the host's timezone, and the offset is ignored.

end.description: Timed event: the end instant, later than start. All-day event: midnight (T00:00:00) on the day after the last day (exclusive); only the date as written is used, and it is later than start's date.

allDay.description: true for an all-day event, whose start and end are read as calendar dates in the host's timezone.
